prayerExcerpt.en-US: And then you must accept salvation from God to be your helmet and receive the word of God from the Spirit to use as a sword.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Tomai, enfim, o capacete da salvação e o gládio do espírito, isto é, a Palavra de Deus.

meta.basis: 'Before the alb is put on, should this not completely cover the ordinary clothing at the neck, an amice should be used' (GIRM 336); all who wear an alb should use a cincture and an amice 'unless, due to the form of the alb, they are not needed' (GIRM 119). The GIRM gives no form: an oblong of white linen with a small cross in the middle and two tapes is the traditional amice, whose vesting prayer calls it galeam salutis, 'the helmet of salvation' (Catholic Encyclopedia, 'Amice'), the words of Eph 6:17 in the excerpt, from the First Reading of Thursday of the Thirtieth Week in Ordinary Time, Year II. White linen: the norms give it no colour.
